scope_statement: Counterfactual analysis only. The WaitAnimState policy was NOT changed, no compiler code was changed, no candidate is called executable, no semantics were inferred, no existing M12 record was modified and no Git write was issued. COUNTERFACTUAL_WAIT_GATE_CLOSED is an analytical view, not an executable state.

counterfactual_wait_analysis.name: COUNTERFACTUAL_WAIT_GATE_CLOSED
counterfactual_wait_analysis.removed_condition: origin=record AND source_type=RPG.GameCore.WaitAnimState AND policy=REJECT_NOT_NOOP AND reason=BEHAVIOR_AFFECTING_NODE_NOT_COMPILED
counterfactual_wait_analysis.removed_blame_attribution: BEHAVIOR_AFFECTING_NODE_NOT_COMPILED arising from any non-WaitAnimState operation is retained

residual_blocker_distribution.note: residual_0 is the number of bodies that WaitAnimState alone would release. It is zero.

required_runtime_contexts_via_ExecutionC: crit_rate and crit_damage for the non-DOT path
ToughnessCommitContext for the bounded stance path
explicitly_rejected: any AttackProperty key outside the accepted set -> EXECUTABLE_REFERENCE_DAMAGE_MIXED_STATE_FIELDS
any arguments key outside the accepted set -> EXECUTABLE_REFERENCE_DAMAGE_ARGUMENTS_UNSUPPORTED
AttackType DOT combined with StanceValue or StanceDamageType -> EXECUTABLE_REFERENCE_DOT_MIXED_STATE_FIELDS
current_reference_damage_acceptance_base.ref02_note: OrdinaryReferencePacket._SPECIAL_KEYS refuses these names outright, so SPHitRatio and HitSplitRatio are rejected by the REF02 packet independently of the compiler allowlist.

damage_mixed_field_signatures.target_presence: PROVEN_PRESENT — the MIXED branch is unreachable unless the earlier isinstance(target, Mapping) check passed, so every offender necessarily had a mapping target; the 45 operations whose target field was not carried by the upstream census projection are child operations and were not re-projected here.

minimal_damage_deltas.runtime_input_only_gaps: none of the 185 mixed-field bodies has a _MISSING-class payload blocker on the damage operation itself; runtime inputs are still required by the executor but are not what rejects the operation

heal_residual_frontier.kind_mapping_blockers: none present in this data; no repository artifact maps HealHP to a PacketKind, which this analysis records as an absence rather than a blocker code
heal_residual_frontier.why: Only 2 heal bodies reach a residual of 1 (each with EXECUTABLE_REFERENCE_RETARGET_TARGET_UNSUPPORTED) and 1 heal body has UNSUPPORTED_HEAL_FORMULA alone, whereas 32 damage bodies reach a residual of 1 with the single class EXECUTABLE_REFERENCE_DAMAGE_MIXED_STATE_FIELDS. The heal frontier is not narrower.

position_precedence_rule: BETWEEN_SETTLEMENTS if more than one settlement operation and the wait ordinal lies strictly between the first and last
BEFORE_SETTLEMENT if the wait ordinal precedes the first settlement operation
AFTER_COMPLETION if a completion marker exists and the wait follows it
BEFORE_COMPLETION if a completion marker exists and the wait follows the last settlement operation
AFTER_SETTLEMENT if no completion marker exists and the wait follows the last settlement operation

minimum_residual_candidates.ranking_rule: fewest residual blockers, then fewer non-settlement siblings, then fewer operations, then AvatarID, then SkillID

single_additional_blocker_unlock_counts.explanation: With the counterfactual wait gate closed, removing one further blocker class releases every body whose entire residual set is that class.

two_additional_blocker_unlock_counts.explanation: Cumulative: bodies whose entire residual set is a subset of the stated classes.

special_top_candidate_audit.scope: every candidate tied at the minimum residual blocker count, plus the seven named minimum-original-blocker candidates
special_top_candidate_audit.compiler_condition: behavior_compiler.py line 441: if any(key not in allowed_attack_fields for key in attack): return EXECUTABLE_REFERENCE_DAMAGE_MIXED_STATE_FIELDS, where attack = arguments.AttackProperty

recommended_next_task: Decide one narrow scope: whether the presence of an uninterpreted extra AttackProperty field (principally SPHitRatio, which REF02's own _SPECIAL_KEYS already refuses) should be representable as an explicitly excluded field, so that the 49 bodies whose entire residual set is EXECUTABLE_REFERENCE_DAMAGE_MIXED_STATE_FIELDS can be assessed as a group. Do not redesign the compiler globally and do not decide native animation timing or damage semantics.

recommendation.reason: A narrow, repeated residual signature exists: EXECUTABLE_REFERENCE_DAMAGE_MIXED_STATE_FIELDS alone accounts for 49 of the 241 bodies, and 77 of the 185 mixed-field bodies differ from the accepted baseline by exactly one field (SPHitRatio). No policy change is proposed here.

non_claims: WaitAnimState is not asserted safe to omit; the counterfactual view is not an executable state.
Extra AttackProperty fields are not asserted to be ignorable.
No field semantics were inferred beyond existing authority.
